proofs.race_free:
by
  refine ⟨finalState unitOps (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ()), rfl, ?_⟩
  have htrace : (finalState unitOps (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ())).trace = traceData := by rfl
  rw [htrace]
  decide
proofs.segment_equivalence:
by
  intro input outside
  rw [segmentation_data]
  refine ⟨finalState ops input outside, rfl, ?_, rfl⟩
  have htrace : (finalState ops input outside).trace = traceData := by rfl
  rw [htrace]
  decide
